G1_unambiguity.justification: The vector-span requirement, input structure, costs, and single-target edge case are all stated clearly enough to determine one interpretation.

G2_completeness.justification: It provides all necessary definitions, constraints, input and output formats, feasibility information, and examples.

G3_faithfulness.justification: With exactly n−1 vectors spanning the zero-sum hyperplane, the underlying available-edge graph is a tree, and spanning all target differences is exactly equivalent to connecting all required sites in the original problem.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is coherent and readable, though the abstract procurement and vector-space framing is somewhat more contrived than the original cabling formulation.
